//: Local-dev hostnames for this deployment's Site Projects. The one place
to change them. Imported by every site.config.dev.tsx as
'@shared/dev-hosts.json', and read by lehrer-core.star and `lehrer dev
check` so the tooling and the bundle cannot disagree.
*.local.openedx.io needs no /etc/hosts entry: upstream Open edX publishes
it as a public wildcard A record pointing at 127.0.0.1. That makes hot
reload depend on public DNS, so it breaks offline or behind a resolver
that filters the name. `lehrer dev check --deployment-config` reports
that before you start. Point these at any name that resolves to 127.0.0.1
if you would rather not depend on it; a deployment whose production LMS is
learn.mit.edu may prefer a subdomain of it so local dev mirrors prod.

port webpack-dev-server binds is declared separately in ../../dev-ports.yaml
